title: Planetfall
shortDescription: Survive a crash landing on an alien world.
description: Your shift as a junior ensign aboard the Stellar Patrol Ship Feinstein begins with a deck to scrub. A shipboard emergency sends you scrambling for an escape pod. You land on an apparently deserted planet, where a little robot named Floyd helps you explore an abandoned research complex and piece together what happened to its inhabitants.
author: Infocom

reviews.author: floyd_fan
reviews.title: Floyd is unforgettable
reviews.body: Planetfall is charming, funny, and surprisingly moving. Floyd the robot is one of the greatest NPCs in gaming history.

reviews.author: scifi_explorer
reviews.title: Meretzky's masterpiece
reviews.body: Steve Meretzky's debut game is a triumph. The writing is witty, the world is richly described, and the puzzles are fair.
